title: PDF export of Shutdown Logic uses the Plan dates; Daily Report PDF uses the snapshot dates after the Plan was edited

steps.do: Open SL page, collapse histogram, Export, PDF, Export
steps.why: Export panel: PDF File enabled (Excel disabled), Overall mode. Downloaded 'QA S26 Ramp_QA ETM-8042 8836_Overall_20261126.pdf' (1 page).

steps.do: Read the Full Shutdown Timeframe in the PDF
steps.expected: 15 Feb 2026 to 25 Feb 2026, not 08 Feb to 22 Feb
steps.why: The Overall PDF has no text label 'Full Shutdown Timeframe'. Read from the render: Gantt axis first column 15 (week header 'Sun 15/02', next 'Sun 22/02'), Ramp Down marker at 15, Ramp Up marker between 25 and 26; axis runs on to 28. No 08 Feb anywhere. Consistent with 15-25 Feb but a person should confirm the axis reading counts as the timeframe.
steps.answer: user 26 Nov: axis 15 Feb to 25 Feb, no 08 Feb

steps.do: Read first day of the Day numbering in the PDF
steps.why: The Overall PDF has no 'Day N' numbering (text layer and render show only date columns 15..28 with Ramp Down at 15). Cannot read Day 1 from this file; the first date column is 15 Feb, Ramp Down at 15 Feb.
steps.answer: user 26 Nov (a): first date column 15 Feb counts as Day 1

steps.do: Edit Plan 'QA ETM-8042 8836' to 18 Feb 2026 09:00 - 20 Feb 2026 09:00, Save
steps.expected: Toast Edit Success, badge 18 Feb 09:00 - 20 Feb 09:00
steps.why: Toast 'Edit Success / Edit Plan Successfully.' read; badge text 'Ramp Down/Up Date: 18 Feb 2026 09:00 - 20 Feb 2026 09:00'. Picture step-4b.png: loaded Plan card with the 18-20 Feb badge (toast in step-4.png, gone before the card loaded).

Header date 15 Feb 2026, DOM buttons: Export, Unfreeze, Save[disabled]. Export dialog (File Type PDF, Mode Only Current Date default, Timeframe Full Shutdown Timeframe). Downloaded 'QA S26 Ramp_QA ETM-8042 8836_DailyReport_Day1_20260215.pdf' (2 pages).

steps.do: Read timeframe/date axis in the Daily Report PDF
steps.expected: 15 Feb to 25 Feb (snapshot), not 18 to 20 Feb
steps.why: PDF page 2 axis 'Feb 2026' columns 15,16,...,25; Ramp Down marker at 15, Ramp Up marker at right edge after 25. First 15 Feb, last 25 Feb. 18-20 Feb not used as range. PDF title: 'Daily Report: QA ETM-8042 8836 15 Feb 2026 (Daily report cut-off: 22:00.)'.

steps.do: Read Day numbering of the PDF (file name and Day label)
steps.why: File name '..._DailyReport_Day1_20260215.pdf' = Day1 / 20260215. No other 'Day N' label inside the PDF (only the title date 15 Feb 2026). Plan at that time was 18-20 Feb, but the file says Day1 for 15 Feb.

steps.do: Previous-day arrow until disabled: 14 Feb 2026; read Export state; Export PDF
steps.expected: Export enabled on 14 Feb 2026 (Day0); PDF of 14 Feb, file name Day0/20260214
steps.why: Arrow disabled at header date 14 Feb 2026. DOM: Export enabled (no disabled attribute), Unfreeze shown, Save[disabled]. Downloaded 'QA S26 Ramp_QA ETM-8042 8836_DailyReport_Day0_20260214.pdf'; title 'Daily Report: QA ETM-8042 8836 14 Feb 2026', no tasks, axis Jan-Mar 2026.

steps.do: Edit Plan back to 15 Feb 2026 09:00 - 25 Feb 2026 18:00, Save
steps.expected: Toast Edit Success, badge 15 Feb 09:00 - 25 Feb 18:00
steps.why: Toast 'Edit Success' read; badge 'Ramp Down/Up Date: 15 Feb 2026 09:00 - 25 Feb 2026 18:00'. Retaken: step-9.png shows the loaded card, badge 15-25 Feb and the toast.
